note: Election of the ten Larne Borough councillors, two for each of the five wards, polled Wednesday 17 May 1961 in Gardenmore Ward only (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1961, p. 10). Central was uncontested after W. S. McIlroy withdrew; Inver and Townparks had two nominations each; Curran had one, the other seat becoming a casual vacancy filled at a later election (Larne Times, 4, 11 and 25 May 1961). No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. 'A casual vacancy arises in the Curran Ward through the decision of Mr. R. McFetridge not to seek re-nomination'; nomination day for the vacancy was 7 June 1961 (Larne Times, 25 May 1961, p. 4). That later election is not part of this round. Returned unopposed.
